papers.title: CAP: Towards PPG Universal Representation Learning with Patient-level Supervision
papers.what: Learns a PPG encoder by contrastively anchoring the signal to patient-level clinical text distilled from EHRs for 2,279 patients; average +26.7% relative over baselines across four cardiorespiratory tasks, up to +87.6% on respiratory rate.
papers.builds_on: Foundation Models for Biosignals (Gu 2025, 2XWEG7AF); Sensor2Text (Chen 2024, ELYUE3NF); How Mask Matters (Zhang 2023, 6INGKIJV)

papers.title: Tandem Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
papers.what: Co-generates each reasoning rollout with a trained senior and a frozen weaker junior, rewards the pair, and applies GRPO to the senior; matches solo accuracy while making the chain of thought legible and transferable to the junior.

papers.title: MetaWorld: Scaling Multi-Agent Video World Models from Single-view Video Data
papers.what: Trains multi-agent video world models from single-view clips by decomposing ego-motion from subject trajectory, and couples views with per-frame cross-attention in a video DiT to keep the shared 3D world consistent.

papers.title: Prisma-World: Camera-Controllable Multi-Agent Video World Model
papers.what: Generates consistent multi-agent video via a single full-attention sequence with multi-agent RoPE and relative-camera-geometry injection, plus a synthetic UE5 dataset with exact camera labels; the geometry-conditioned counterpart to MetaWorld.
